summary: Jackson County, OR lookout first built 1925, rebuilt around 1959-61, removed in 1967; a 2018 visit found solar panels and a comm tower on the site.

facts.design: 10-foot wooden tower (1925); later 10-foot wooden live-in tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Lookout removed in 1967; a 2018 visit found solar panels and a small comm tower on the site

staffing.status: seasonal summer posts with named lookouts in 1939-1960 reports; no later staffing found

visit.trail_note: A 2018 visitor found gravel and two-track roads to within half a mile, walked the last half mile, and reports that a 4x4 or ATV can drive all the way to the top. No source says whether the public may go up.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1959; the Forest Lookouts page's district reports show material bought in 1960 and construction finished in 1961. The story reports both.

The register says destroyed, firelookout.com says abandoned, and the 2018 blog says removed when abandoned. All three give 1967, so the year is treated as agreed and the wording is reported as differing.
A 1964 survey note calls the tower abandoned, but the 1965 district report records window repairs at the lookout. The story reports the 1965 repair next to the survey wording.

notes_for_editor: Dates for the replacement cab conflict (1959 vs 1960-61). No source states current public access, so the access key is omitted; the brief's access 'unknown' stands. The 2018 blog is a personal visit account and the only description of the site today. The 1964 survey slab and the survey disk are not confirmed present today. The 360cities summit page returned 403, so it was not used. Photo captions (1946, 1954, 1959-67, 2007) are not added as photos because no image URLs were in the cache. The fflos 1809 record and brief's events agree with the register.
